Video type: A man builds a house with all four walls facing south. A bear walks past. What colour is the bear?
column7: A location where every direction from the house is south is the North Pole, where polar bears live.

Video type: A girl drops her phone into a swimming pool, but it stays completely dry. How?
column7: The trick is that there was no water in the swimming pool!

Video type: A shopkeeper has 12 bananas. All except 5 are sold. How many are left?
column7: The words all except five mean that five bananas remain.

Video type: A delivery driver travels down a one-way street in the wrong direction. A police officer sees him but does nothing. Why?
column4: The driver is in a hurry
column7: The delivery driver is walking, not driving a vehicle.

Video type: You buy a rooster and put it on a roof. Which way will its egg roll?
column7: Roosters are male chickens, so they do not lay eggs!

Video type: A magician puts a coin inside an empty glass and covers it. Without touching the glass, he makes the coin disappear. What did he do?
column7: A simple trick is to make the coin invisible by switching off the light in a dark room.

Video type: A man shaves several times every day but still has a beard. Who is he?
column7: A barber shaves other people's beards as part of his job.

Video type: Two people are born on the same day, in the same year, to the same parents, but they are not twins. How?
column7: They could be two members of a set of triplets or even quadruplets.

Video type: A restaurant serves a dish called elephant soup. It contains no elephant. What is it?
column3: A soup named after a place
column4: A soup with a funny name
column7: Restaurant menu names can be playful and misleading. The name alone does not tell you the ingredients.

Video type: A man enters a room, turns on a fan, and leaves. The room becomes cooler, but the temperature outside does not change. Why?
column7: A fan makes moving air feel cooler, although it does not actually lower the room temperature.

Video type: What can you add to a bucket to make it lighter without removing anything?
column7: Adding a hole allows water to drain out, reducing the bucket's total weight.

Video type: A person walks into a room carrying a match. Inside are a candle, a fireplace and a gas lamp. What should they light first?
column7: Nothing else can be lit until the match itself is struck.

Video type: A man looks at a photograph and says, 'I have no brothers or sisters, but that man's father is my father's son.' Who is in the photograph?
column7: Since he has no siblings, my father's son refers to the man himself. So the photograph shows his son.

Video type: A woman buys a pair of shoes and immediately throws one away. Why?
column7: She bought shoes for a one-legged mannequin or display, so she only needed one. The puzzle depends on the unusual shopping situation.

Video type: A man has a pet that can repeat everything he says, but it never speaks. What is it?
column7: A recording device can replay every sound without actually speaking or understanding it.

Video type: You are in a race and overtake the person in second place. What position are you in now?
column7: You take the position of the person you overtook, not the position of the leader.

Video type: A person writes a word with six letters. Remove one letter and eight remain. What word is it?
column7: The word queue has five letters after its first letter is removed, but its pronunciation still sounds like the letter Q. This is a wordplay trick.

Video type: A man enters a room full of people. Everyone is silent, but he knows they are all talking. How?
column7: People can communicate through sign language without making any sound.

Video type: A family has five daughters. Each daughter has one brother. How many children are in the family?
column7: All five daughters share the same brother, so the family has six children.

Video type: What can you make that nobody, including you, can ever keep?
column7: You can make a mistake, but you cannot keep it as something you own forever in the same sense as an object.

Video type: A man orders a glass of water at a restaurant. The waiter suddenly shouts at him. The man smiles, says thank you and leaves. Why?
column7: The waiter startled him, curing his hiccups. The man no longer needed the water.

Video type: Which word becomes shorter when you add two letters to it?
column7: Adding the letters E and R to short makes the word shorter into the comparative word shorter.

Video type: What has 4 letters, sometimes 9 letters, but never 5 letters?
column7: The sentence is a statement, not a question. The words themselves have four, nine and five letters respectively.

Video type: A man has three apples. He gives away two, eats one and puts the last one in his pocket. How many apples does he have?
column7: He started with three, gave away two and ate one. The pocket detail is a deliberate distraction.
